exact_statement: For every finite actual adaptive restriction tree of uniform Boolean signs with entropy-preserving nonincreasing-influence affine/character child resets, retain all original reaches and complete leaves. At each internal node let c=query influence plus average actual reset release, L=entropy decrement and b=L-Kc. Then sum_internal reach*c+E I(leaf)=I(root), and D_K(root)=sum_internal reach*b+E D_K(leaf). Thus b<=epsilon*c at every node and D_K(leaf)<=epsilon*I(leaf) at every leaf imply H(root)<=(K+epsilon)I(root), without depth loss. Nonuniform allowances are valid if their original-reach influence allocation is bounded by epsilon I(root). This convention is stable under grafting, finite macro grouping, branch-dependent affine charts, certified early stopping and sequential independent tensor trees. If FEI(K+epsilon) fails, a least-essential-dimension finite maximal-D_(K+epsilon) witness has all smaller affine-child bounds D_K<=epsilon I, and one proper actual block with L<=(K+epsilon)c would contradict its positivity. No unbounded optimizer is assumed. Charging epsilon I(current) instead can repeatedly overallocate: on k-control activation of t=2^k disjoint bent2 copies, the actual control-first/all-data tree has mean depth4-2^(1-k), root I=2^-k[t+k(1-2^-t)] tending1 and remaining-influence occupation Omega=2^-k[k t+(1-2^-t)k(k+1)/2+t^2+t/2]>=t. At k10 this actual2058-bit formula has I<=517/512 and Omega/I>1000. This refutes the budget-compilation inference, not FEI or a claim that actual bills saturate that allowance. No universally funded original pair is selected.
